status: Implemented and source-frozen. 37 Cargo spatial native test groups, 62 UI tests and TypeScript check passed. Direct production and unit-test Clippy diagnostics are clean; authoritative all-target rerun awaits the shared workspace lock.
algorithm_origin: Original implementations of mathematical methods; no recovered Evoto models, algorithms or visual-parity claims

methods.label: Local cosine shrinkage
methods.name: Local cosine shrinkage
methods.mechanism: Soft-threshold a five-by-five discrete cosine transform and reconstruct its centre while retaining luminance ratios.
methods.distinctness: Cosine basis across a 5x5 patch differs from Haar block wavelets and scalar residual clipping.

methods.label: Biorthogonal lifting cleanup
methods.name: Biorthogonal lifting cleanup
methods.mechanism: Apply reversible CDF 5/3 predict-update lifting along both axes and shrink its detail coefficients.
methods.distinctness: Predict-update biorthogonal lifting differs from Haar coefficient thresholding and DCT analysis.

methods.label: Geometric colour median
methods.name: Geometric colour median
methods.mechanism: Use eight Weiszfeld iterations to minimize joint RGB distance; unlike a medoid, the result can lie between samples.
methods.distinctness: Continuous joint-distance minimizer differs from sample medoid and channelwise median estimators.

methods.label: Iterative colour mode
methods.name: Iterative colour mode
methods.mechanism: Move a Gaussian colour kernel five times toward the measured local colour-density mode.
methods.distinctness: Kernel centre moves over five density iterations; sigma/bilateral filters retain a fixed range centre.

methods.label: Pairwise robust colour location
methods.name: Pairwise robust colour location
methods.mechanism: Take the weighted median of all local Walsh pair averages rather than individual samples.
methods.distinctness: Walsh pair-average distribution is distinct from sample ranks, trimmed means and median-of-means.

methods.label: Geodesic colour averaging
methods.name: Geodesic colour averaging
methods.mechanism: Measure shortest four-connected contrast paths and average samples by their path cost.
methods.distinctness: Shortest contrast paths use connectivity, unlike straight spatial distance or recursive domain smoothing.

methods.label: Spatial patch low-rank repair
methods.name: Spatial patch low-rank repair
methods.mechanism: Measure covariance of overlapping nine-dimensional luminance patches and shrink its principal spatial mode.
methods.distinctness: Covariance is over nine spatial luminance dimensions rather than three RGB channels.

methods.label: Covariance-distance smoothing
methods.name: Covariance-distance smoothing
methods.mechanism: Use a regularized inverse RGB covariance to measure range weights before averaging colours.
methods.distinctness: Inverse covariance defines the range metric; earlier RGB covariance shrinkage reconstructs principal-component amplitudes.

methods.label: Multiplicative Lee restoration
methods.name: Multiplicative Lee restoration
methods.mechanism: Estimate multiplicative noise using local relative variance and a signal-dependent gain.
methods.distinctness: Signal-dependent multiplicative relative-noise variance differs from additive-noise Wiener estimation.

methods.label: Frost spatial damping
methods.name: Frost spatial damping
methods.mechanism: Use measured coefficient of variation to set exponential spatial damping for multiplicative-noise smoothing.
methods.distinctness: Variation-dependent exponential spatial damping differs from Lee gain and Gaussian range weighting.

methods.label: Gamma-MAP speckle restoration
methods.name: Gamma-MAP speckle restoration
methods.mechanism: Use homogeneous, Gamma-MAP texture, and strong-edge regimes derived from measured relative variance.
methods.distinctness: Three-regime Gamma posterior mode includes a quadratic texture solution rather than Lee linear gain.
methods.qualificationNote: The low-noise strong-edge regime intentionally returns the source; exercise the homogeneous/texture estimator on the qualification chart.

methods.label: Fourth-order surface repair
methods.name: Fourth-order surface repair
methods.mechanism: Solve the centre of a bounded biharmonic finite-difference stencil rather than a harmonic neighbour mean.
methods.distinctness: Fourth-order stencil includes signed diagonal and distance-two terms, unlike harmonic averaging.

methods.label: Fractional spatial detail
methods.name: Fractional spatial detail
methods.mechanism: Adjust a truncated fractional-Laplacian residual with power-law distance weights.
methods.distinctness: Truncated power-law nonlocal derivative differs from a difference of two box means.

methods.label: Parabolic background separation
methods.name: Parabolic background separation
methods.mechanism: Estimate a non-flat parabolic morphological opening and adjust detail above that background.
methods.distinctness: Non-flat quadratic structuring function differs from flat morphology or geodesic reconstruction.

methods.label: Oriented scratch repair
methods.name: Oriented scratch repair
methods.mechanism: Combine line opening and closing along an authored normal to reduce thin bright and dark scratches.
methods.distinctness: Line opening/closing is directional and separable from earlier isotropic top-hat cleanup.

methods.label: Quadrature phase detail
methods.name: Quadrature phase detail
methods.mechanism: Normalize a local even residual by truncated Riesz-like quadrature amplitude for bounded phase-sensitive detail.
methods.distinctness: Even/odd quadrature normalization differs from Hessian curvature or residual gain alone.

methods.label: Spectral surprise detail
methods.name: Spectral surprise detail
methods.mechanism: Remove local log-spectrum averages, reconstruct spectral-residual saliency, and use it to weight detail.
methods.distinctness: Log-spectrum residual saliency differs from an authored sinusoidal notch or spatial entropy.

methods.label: MAD impulse repair
methods.name: MAD impulse repair
methods.mechanism: Replace luminance outliers using a median absolute deviation test and an explicit minimum separation.
methods.distinctness: MAD scale tests differ from expanding-window extrema or ordinary median replacement.

methods.label: Circular hue smoothing
methods.name: Circular hue smoothing
methods.mechanism: Average chroma directions on the unit circle while retaining chroma magnitude and luminance where gamut permits.
methods.distinctness: Unit-direction averaging preserves chroma strength rather than filtering chroma coordinates.

methods.label: Chroma strength median
methods.name: Chroma strength median
methods.mechanism: Filter chroma magnitude by a weighted median while retaining the original hue direction and luminance.
methods.distinctness: Scalar chroma magnitude changes while hue direction stays fixed, unlike chroma coordinate medians.

methods.label: Local white-patch adaptation
methods.name: Local white-patch adaptation
methods.mechanism: Estimate channel illumination from local upper percentiles and adapt colour while retaining luminance.
methods.distinctness: Upper channel percentiles estimate a local illuminant; this is a colour adaptation heuristic.

methods.label: Local gray-edge adaptation
methods.name: Local gray-edge adaptation
methods.mechanism: Estimate channel illumination from local gradient energy and adapt colour while retaining luminance.
methods.distinctness: Derivative-energy illuminant estimation differs from intensity-percentile white-patch adaptation.

methods.label: Luminance skewness balance
methods.name: Luminance skewness balance
methods.mechanism: Use the measured third central moment to reduce local luminance asymmetry with a bounded correction.
methods.distinctness: Measured third central moment corrects asymmetry rather than variance or histogram rank.

methods.label: Tail-weighted detail
methods.name: Tail-weighted detail
methods.mechanism: Use the measured fourth central moment to adjust detail according to local tail weight.
methods.distinctness: Measured fourth central moment adjusts tail response rather than entropy or third-moment balance.

methods.label: Monotonic edge limiter
methods.name: Monotonic edge limiter
methods.mechanism: Reconstruct from slope-limited neighbouring intervals to suppress directional overshoot while retaining linear ramps.
methods.distinctness: Monotone slope-limited interval reconstruction differs from polynomial residual fits and shock evolution.

fixes.problem: The fixed 256-edge nearest-cell grid could miss a 3x3 authored selection and sensor-scale features entirely.
fixes.change: 44 finite-footprint local methods (19 existing plus 25 new) now use immutable native-resolution stripes and 192-pixel tiles with four-pixel halos. Every original pixel remains addressable; selection coverage blends once.
fixes.memory: At most 2,097,152 RGB source cells (24 MiB) per stripe, a reused four-row source cache up to approximately 11 MiB, plus bounded tile/evaluator scratch. No full-resolution source clone.

limits: 56 geometric, donor, iterative and globally conditioned methods retain a maximum 256-edge working grid.
Native local support reaches at most four pixels; this is not large-area semantic inpainting or learned detail reconstruction.
For unusually wide selections exceeding the native stripe budget, processing falls back to the 256-edge path rather than exceeding the scratch bound.
Native selection neighbours must be selected; a single isolated selected pixel lacks a repair reference.
DCT and spectral residual methods use 5x5 patches; low-rank patches use nine-dimensional luminance descriptors with fixed eight-step leading-mode estimation.
Lee, Frost and Gamma-MAP assume multiplicative noise; gray-edge and white-patch adaptation are local illuminant heuristics and can alter intended scene colours.
Rendering runs on the CPU reference; no Evoto-trained data is included.
